description: Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aparcamiento para personas con movilidad reducida; Aparcamientos públicos; Carril bici; Transporte público. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/od/2.1/en/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
